source_assessments.details: A before fusion; B 7-to-768 residual before Center head. Motion input/output 314/75; candidate evidence 399; search 295; future-action 275.

xywh output/reference, xyxy accepted history and candidate geometry; native Center returns normalized cxcywh. Forecast offsets start at current-query gap. VideoClips supplies horizon labels beyond loaded query images, avoiding a tail-slice mismatch.

Normalized mode weights; masked trajectory Gaussian mixture NLL; single-step candidate mixture log density. Soft spatial grid consists of weighted unnormalized Gaussian bumps, expected log sizes, trust and gap. It is not normalized crop-conditional probability mass. Multi-mode benefit and long-gap calibration are unmeasured.

ViT extract no_grad; A/fusion/Center/grid remain differentiable. Zero grid output initially blocks upstream motion gradient through that path, while motion NLL trains motion directly. Detached decision inputs and frozen future/search heads are intentional for the raw stage.

Only initial GT initializes state. Later labels and teacher masks remain loss inputs. Search reads local evidence before the optional extra observation; contextualization sees local plus exactly one executed extra region.

One advance call per track. Selected output separate from next search reference. Accepted-only history remains unchanged on defer while age advances. R3 defer blocks geometry and all modality writes; pause_identity blocks all modality writes; accept_geometry forces geometry; rgb_only/tir_only mask commits. Protected first anchor/template preserved.

Strict parent load, zero motion-grid residual, zero future/search values, local candidate-0 policy at default threshold, inherited single-image double-precision crop and batch stride6, native cxcywh mapping and per-modality template layout restoration. Hardcoded frame5/Hann .65 policy needs comparison with the actual locked configuration; no unsealed YAML was read.

Geometry/history/memory/template tensors are cloned, native template layout is restored, proposals make new memory/history tensors, apply_submission copies the template list, and tracker snapshots retain double crop reference and frame. A later collector must restore the same snapshot for each branch; full replay isolation is unmeasured.

source_assessments.topic: Optimizer, BN, frozen state and order generator
source_assessments.details: Localizer/A lowLR; temporal/evidence highLR; decisions frozen/excluded; ViT eval/no_grad. Fusion/head BN train intentionally, consistent with R2 plan. Independent DataLoader generator and actual per-epoch clip/frame hashes. Before/after backbone/decision state hashes include buffers; strict nested reload and finite norm/change checks exist.

Utility advantage and harm from future IoU/lost fraction have separate targets. R1 defer allowed identity writes and changed history; its old intervention labels are incompatible with R3. Existing realized-utility statistics may inform a new collector, but old trace/intervention plumbing is not R3-compatible.

Real component/proposal calls test zero grid residual, grid-projection gradient, deferred history, six local-candidate masks, joint quarantine, template-stride cloning, bidirectional attention, zero-head keep, native mapping, and independent future-harm supervision. These are simulation-only checks. They do not execute full tracker state installation/restore or pretrained image parity.
